content: Support subfunction 0x1A and 0x56 of UDS service 0x19 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support subfunction 0x1A and 0x56 of UDS service 0x19 to retrieve information for emission related DTCs and supported ECU data. Rationale: Required to fulfill SAE J1979-2 and enhanced diagnostics. Use Case: Support of legislated diagnostic requirements and enhanced diagnostic support.
